config.design: Reconstruct attention5 last-token patterns and mixed values including native layer0 bus, QK RMS norm, rotary embeddings, checkpoint-native product of two QK score matrices (signed, unnormalized routing weights) and output projection. Decompose by head and source token. Align tokens by prefix/negation/adjective/suffix roles and within-role index.
config.factorization: At each aligned slot/head, attention output is scalar P times projected value V. Factorial interaction = P0*Vi (value interaction) + Pi*V0 (routing interaction) + Pa*Vn+Pn*Va (cross terms). Summed over sources/heads.
config.alignment: Role assignment uses tokenizer character offsets. Slots missing in some quartet states use zero P and zero V; factor split on those slots depends on this padding convention. Report common versus noncommon slots separately. Source contributions P*V always sum exactly; padding is not a causal hypothesis.
config.limits: Native trajectory factorization, not mediation or a counterfactual routing experiment. Native-gate failures remain diagnostics; rank only competent familiar A. No new training or reserved-test use.
